description: Publish or update long-form Markdown SEO articles directly to the hosted Nuntior Live Reader (`https://nuntior.com/p/:slug`), Ghost CMS, WordPress, Webflow, Dev.to, Medium, or Hashnode. Use this tool for canonical content-first workflows: publish the full technical article first to get a live canonical URL, then pass that URL into `posts_publish` with `xLinkStrategy: 'first_reply'` to share it across every connected social network. Returns the live `articleId`, `slug`, public `url`, `blogMirrorUrl`, and publication timestamp.

action.description: CMS blog operation: 'list_sites' returns connected blog publications and existing articles, 'publish_article' publishes a new Markdown article, and 'update_article' edits an existing article by slug or ID.

articleId.description: Existing article identifier (`art_...`) when updating an article via `action: 'update_article'`.

canonicalUrl.description: Optional canonical URL (`<link rel="canonical">`) when cross-syndicating an existing blog post to Dev.to, Medium, or Hashnode.

markdownBody.description: Complete long-form article body formatted in standard Markdown (supports headings, code blocks, tables, and links).

platform.description: Destination blog or CMS engine: 'nuntior' (instant hosted reader at nuntior.com/p/:slug), 'ghost', 'wordpress', 'webflow', 'devto', 'medium', or 'hashnode'.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) credited as the publication author.

publishStatus.description: Publication visibility state: 'published' makes the article immediately live; 'draft' stages it for review.

slug.description: Custom URL slug (e.g. 'agent-first-social-mcp-architecture'). Auto-generated from `title` if omitted.

tags.description: Array of topic tags or categories attached to the article for SEO discovery (e.g. `['AI Agents', 'MCP', 'Automation']`).

title.description: Full headline title of the blog article (used for H1, OpenGraph tags, and automatic slug generation).

name: blogs_publish
title: Publish Canonical Blog Articles & Syndication
